notes: Read with docs/design/ascension-requires-play.md, which pre-registers the four claims and their refutations, and with the campaign-plan entry recording that favor never binds -- open-then-build founds 98 universities against a threshold of 2 with zero refusals, so this conjunct is a placement fix rather than an economic one. permissive-breadth falling to 0/40 is a POOL defect surfacing, not the rule overshooting: its fix is a one-line reordering of its preference list, deliberately not made on this branch, because a strategy edited to pass a predicate committed in the same branch measures the edit rather than the rule.
rationale: The win condition now depends on play, and this is the file balance/README.md said should move when it landed. THE CONSTANT: one, ascension-institutions = 2, added as a conjunct of BOTH ascension paths -- apotheosisSatisfied every tick and eraBoundaryPassed at every era boundary Path B counts. Its identity value is 0, which reproduces the predicate that shipped. No other constant, cap or magnitude was touched, and NO TOLERANCE WAS WIDENED: toleranceK stays 3, the committed value and the CLI default, so the flag was not passed. MEASURED DELTAS, all ten inside tolerance at k=3 and the largest 1.55 SE: referenceKnowledgeInstances 3266.59 -> 4016.63 (+750.031, 1.55 SE); referencePopulation and referencePopulationChange each +2134.16 (1.48 SE) to 17866.4 and 17722.4; referenceNodesKnown and referenceNodesGained each +8.1875 (0.73 SE) to 69.0625 and 66.5625; referenceNodesGainedFinalQuarter 4.875 -> 3.21875 (-1.65625, -0.78 SE); referenceGrimoires 283.563 -> 255.219 (-28.3438, -0.64 SE); referenceLibraryDepth 34.125 -> 37.5625 (+3.4375, 0.52 SE); referenceLivingMages 459.875 -> 461.563 (+1.6875, 0.01 SE); referencePeakPopulation 29490 -> 29490, delta exactly zero. THE MECHANISM, proven and not inferred: the sweep round-robins 8 strategies over 32 runs, so each gets 4. In a paired re-run of the whole pool at these coordinates -- same seeds, one constant apart -- every one of 40 paired runs for passive-control, idle-then-declare, denial-warden, narrow-depth, portal-rush and worship-maximizer is BIT-IDENTICAL across the two arms, same snapshotHash. The conjunct changes nothing for a universe that was never going to qualify. What changed is permissive-breadth, which ascended 40/40 before and 0/40 after: it ends every run at one university, the academy the scenario seeds, because it lists fundUniversity behind the always-legal permitTechnique and policyFor never reaches it. Its 4 runs now play to the 2400-tick cap instead of terminating near tick 1094, and a longer run accumulates more of every stock -- which is exactly the sign of every delta above, and why referencePeakPopulation, a max aggregation, moved by exactly zero. THE DIRECTION IS THE POINT: these numbers rose because a universe that used to win by editing the ruleset and then idling now keeps running.
